facts.fact: The Swaziland Meteorological Service's Agrometeorological Unit issued its agromet bulletin for 21-31 October 2024, assessing vegetation condition with FAO-GIEWS NDVI anomaly and Vegetation Health Index imagery.
The Agrometeorological Unit's bulletin is issued per dekad, Issue 03 of season 2024/25 released 4 November 2024 for 21-31 October 2024.

SWZ.note: Imagery in an agromet bulletin comes from FAO; no satellite use in forecasts or warnings stated.
